title.zh: 导数、泰勒近似与敏感性

lead.en: Derive local linear models, prove differentiation rules and mean-value implications, bound Taylor error, and diagnose finite-difference estimates at kinks or below floating-point resolution.
lead.zh: 推导局部线性模型，证明微分规则与中值结论，界定泰勒误差，诊断不可导点和浮点分辨率以下的差分估计。

prerequisites.en: Module 15: quantified limits, continuity, intermediate/extreme value theorems and geometric tails; school powers, radians and function composition from Module 01.
prerequisites.zh: 模块 15：量化极限、连续、介值最值定理与几何尾部；模块 01 的幂、弧度和函数复合。

en: Identify a derivative as both a difference-quotient limit and a first-order local approximation.
Differentiate powers, exponentials, logarithms and trigonometric functions on their stated domains.
Prove product, quotient, chain and inverse rules with their hypotheses.
Apply Rolle/mean value theorems and distinguish stationary, local and global extrema.
Construct Taylor polynomials and bound finite remainders under stated smoothness.
Separate finite-difference truncation, rounding, scaling and nondifferentiable-point failures.
zh: 区分差商极限和一阶局部近似并证明等价。
在明确域上求幂、指数、对数和三角函数导数。
按假设证明积、商、链和反函数规则。
用罗尔中值定理，区分驻点、局部与全局极值。
构造泰勒多项式并按光滑性给余项界。
区分差分截断、舍入、尺度与不可导失败。

text.en: Read Sections 1–2 and derive local approximation examples.
text.zh: 阅读第 1–2 节，推导局部近似例。

text.en: Read derivative definitions and domain qualifications.
text.zh: 阅读导数定义及定义域限制。
检索差商与局部模型等价。

text.en: Read Sections 3–4 and check all theorem hypotheses.
text.zh: 阅读第 3–4 节，检查全部假设。

text.en: Compare analytic, forward and central derivatives.
text.zh: 比较解析、前向与中心导数。

text.en: Read Sections 5–6 and explore local model order.
text.zh: 阅读第 5–6 节，探索局部模型阶数。

text.en: Measure Taylor errors and valid remainder bounds.
text.zh: 测泰勒误差与有效余项界。

text.en: Diagnose kink averages and erased perturbations.
text.zh: 诊断折点平均与被抹去扰动。

text.en: Complete choices and the written chain/Taylor claim.
text.zh: 完成选择与书面链式泰勒主张。

text.en: Read Taylor and floating-point error selections.
text.zh: 阅读泰勒与浮点误差选段。

text.en: Complete the exit task with domain and remainder conditions.
text.zh: 带定义域与余项条件完成结业任务。
